2610.13252.title: Vision Transformers Learn Word Meaning from Images Alone
2610.13252.paper_summary: Can a vision model learn what words mean from pixels alone? We show that the two largest DINOv3 vision transformers organize words rendered in images by word meaning, despite being pretrained using self-supervision on images only, without paired captions, class labels, or other language supervision. We derive word representations from embedding differences between word images and matched controls, then test whether semantically related words are neighbors within each model's embedding space, while controlling for spelling similarity. We find that brand names in the same industry group together, as do nouns from the same semantic domain. Country-capital pairs exhibit consistent vector offsets, similarly to word embeddings trained on text. These word representations also align with the representations of the visual object categories they name. DINOv3-H and DINOv3-7B are, to our knowledge, the first self-supervised vision models to show substantial semantic structure for rendered words. Comparisons with text and speech encoders reveal shared structure among representations of the same words. Contrastive alignment with either encoder further strengthened DINOv3-H's word-level semantic structure, while leaving the other finetuned vision models largely unchanged. Image-only training can therefore teach vision models not just what words look like, but also how their meanings relate.
2610.13252.paper_summary_zh: 一個視覺模型能否僅從像素中學習單詞的意思？我們顯示出，兩個最大的 DINOv3 視覺Transformer能夠根據單詞的意義組織圖像中呈現的單詞，儘管它們僅使用自我監督進行了預訓練，沒有配對的標題、類別標籤或其他語言監督。我們從單詞圖像和匹配對照之間的嵌入差異中推導出單詞表示，然後測試語義相關的單詞在每個模型的嵌入空間中是否為相鄰，並控制拼寫相似性。我們發現同一行業的品牌名稱會聚在一起，來自同一語義領域的名詞也是如此。國家與首都的配對顯示出一致的向量偏移，類似於在文本上訓練的單詞嵌入。這些單詞表示也與它們所命名的視覺物體類別的表示對齊。根據我們的了解，DINOv3-H 和 DINOv3-7B 是首批顯示出渲染單詞顯著語義結構的自我監督視覺模型。與文本和語音編碼器的比較顯示了相同單詞表示之間的共享結構。與任一編碼器的對比對齊進一步加強了 DINOv3-H 的單詞級語義結構，同時對其他微調的視覺模型幾乎沒有影響。因此，僅使用圖像的訓練可以教會視覺模型不僅是單詞的外觀，還有它們的意義之間的關係。
